capabilities: Browse and filter recipe notes in a card grid
Generate a categorised, aisle-sorted shopping list from marked recipes
Aggregate and unit-convert ingredient quantities across recipes
Create batch-cooking session notes with prep lists and cook order
Maintain an ingredient list with categories, dietary groups and alternate names
extras: The manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to treat recipe notes as a filterable collection or to combine their ingredients into aggregated, aisle-ordered shopping lists.
summary: Recipe manager that browses and filters recipe notes, plans batch-cooking sessions, and generates shopping lists sorted by store aisle.
